issue_context.title: Add an example demonstrating run conditions
issue_context.body:
From what I can tell, none of our examples use run conditions at all (except for `.on_update()`). We should address this, but IMO there should be a separate issue for this.

_Originally posted by @JoJoJet in https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/issues/7605#issuecomment-1427101406_
            
This should capture the combinators added in #7605 as well.

review_comments:
Am I correct in thinking that once #7605 in merged we could do something like this?
```rs
.run_if(resource_exists::<InputCounter>())
.and_then(|counter: Res<InputCounter>| counter.is_changed() && !counter.is_added())
```
Yep, precisely :) Interestingly, the short circuiting nature would make sure that the second run condition doesn't panic. That's nice.
This should explain the run conditions must *all* be true.
These should both have notes that they're systems :)
